title: Constant-time bearer token comparison via subtle::ConstantTimeEq is correct and must stay
description: Both admin check_bearer_token functions use subtle::ConstantTimeEq for the comparison. A future contributor might replace this with str == str for 'simplicity'. Don't: even on a loopback-only endpoint, a timing oracle lets a local attacker leak the token character by character via high-resolution timing. The overhead is negligible and the protection is real.
